scores.tell: Books fill the full width and bleed off the left/right edges with no margin; the stack is cropped and there is no isolated hero. It reads as a scene, not an object.
none. The saddle is large and centered with its stirrup close to the bottom, similar to the real saddle-type card.
The calculator is tilted and fills most of the card with a clean silhouette. The pattern is a little busy behind it, but it reads well.

The table is small and sits mid-frame, with two stools and a wide landscape around it. The hero is spread across three objects and the background is busy. It is closer to the real swing card than most, but the scale is weak.
The dome and tunnel are off-center to the right, with a large empty crater at the bottom right. Attention is split between the dome, the tunnel, and the crater.
none. The hat is large and tilted, with tight margins and a strong silhouette on a plain ring background.
The cauldron, frame, and campfire all compete for attention. The logs touch the bottom edge and the poles touch the sides. The busy forest sits right behind the hero.
The palm is large and tilted. The sand strip at the bottom is slightly heavy, and the fronds nearly touch the top.
The cauldron is centered, fills the card well, and has clear margins. It is a little static and symmetric, and the floor and stripes add a mild competing band.
The chair is tilted and centered with a clear read. It is slightly small, with a lot of empty ground at the bottom, and the beige plinth is a big flat block.
